title: Publish an event when an optional listener bean is absent
summary: A null listener factory now leaves its consumer empty and lets publication return. A later ordered listener received E1 and E2 exactly once each.

change.description: An event-listener factory method may return null. Dispatch now recognizes Spring’s placeholder and skips invocation on that absent listener.

notes: The parent threw before the later listener saw either event. A genuine optional listener still received E1 once on both revisions.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-context-5.2.1.RELEASE-q25. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
